description_en: Creates a private network traffic diversion configuration for a specified VPC and selects the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) to be connected. This operation is executed asynchronously and returns a task ID
description_zh: 为指定 VPC 创建私网引流配置，并选择要接入的弹性网卡。接口异步执行，返回任务 ID
kebab_example: aliyun ndr create-private-traction --vpc-instance-id vpc-bp1example --gwlbe-vsw-info-list ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-h --max-bandwidth 20 --max-traffic='-1' --time-config '00:00 23:59 * *' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePrivateTraction

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC instance
parameters.name: vpc_instance_id

fields.help_en: The vSwitch CIDR block. This parameter is required when you create a vSwitch
fields.help_zh: 交换机网段。创建新交换机时必填
fields.name: cidr_block

fields.help_en: The vSwitch instance ID. This parameter is required when you use an existing vSwitch
fields.help_zh: 交换机实例 ID。使用已有交换机时必填
fields.name: vsw_instance_id

fields.help_en: The zone ID
fields.help_zh: 可用区 ID
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The list of vSwitch configurations used by the Gateway Load Balancer endpoint. The list must include 1 to 2 different zones
parameters.help_zh: 网关负载均衡终端节点使用的交换机配置列表，必须包含 1～2 个不同可用区
parameters.name: gwlbe_vsw_info_list

parameters.help_en: The private network traffic diversion bandwidth. Unit: Gbps. Valid values: 10 to 50. The value must be a multiple of 10
parameters.help_zh: 私网引流带宽，单位为 Gbps。创建或修改配置时取值为 10～50，且必须为 10 的整数倍
parameters.name: max_bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The maximum private network traffic diversion volume. Unit: GB. A value of -1 indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 私网引流流量上限，单位为 GB。-1 表示不限制
parameters.name: max_traffic

parameters.help_en: The traffic diversion time configuration. The format is start time, end time, day of the week, and day of the month. The start time and end time use the HH:mm format. Fixed start and end times or periodic configurations are supported. For example, 00:00 23:59 * * indicates that the task runs all day every day. You cannot specify both the day of the week and the day of the month
parameters.help_zh: 引流时间配置，格式依次为开始时间、结束时间、星期和日期，其中开始时间和结束时间使用 HH:mm 格式。支持固定起止时间或周期配置，例如 00:00 23:59 * * 表示每天全天执行。星期与日期不能同时限定
parameters.name: time_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically connect new ENIs added to the VPC
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动接入该VPC后续新增的网卡
parameters.name: auto_access

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs of elastic network interfaces (ENIs)
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡实例 ID 列表
parameters.name: eni_instance_id_list

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 目的地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: destination_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The destination port range. The format is start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required when the protocol is TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 目的端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: destination_port_range

fields.help_en: The priority of the sub-rule. Valid values: 1 to 16777216. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Priorities must be unique within the same direction
fields.help_zh: 子规则优先级，取值范围为 1～16777216。数字越小，优先级越高；同一方向内优先级不可重复
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The matched network protocol. Valid values: ALL (all protocols), ICMP, TCP, and UDP
fields.help_zh: 匹配的网络协议。ALL 表示全部协议，ICMP、TCP、UDP 表示对应协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The source CIDR block. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 源地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: source_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The source port range. The format is start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required when the protocol is TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 源端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: source_port_range

fields.help_en: The action for matched traffic. A value of accept indicates that traffic is collected. A value of drop indicates that traffic is not collected
fields.help_zh: 匹配流量的处理动作。accept 表示采集，drop 表示不采集
fields.name: sub_rule_action

fields.help_en: The list of outbound filter sub-rules
fields.help_zh: 出方向过滤子规则列表
fields.name: egress_sub_rules

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 目的地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: destination_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The destination port range. The format is start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required when the protocol is TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 目的端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: destination_port_range

fields.help_en: The priority of the sub-rule. Valid values: 1 to 16777216. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Priorities must be unique within the same direction
fields.help_zh: 子规则优先级，取值范围为 1～16777216。数字越小，优先级越高；同一方向内优先级不可重复
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The matched network protocol. Valid values: ALL (all protocols), ICMP, TCP, and UDP
fields.help_zh: 匹配的网络协议。ALL 表示全部协议，ICMP、TCP、UDP 表示对应协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The source CIDR block. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 源地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: source_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The source port range. The format is start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required when the protocol is TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 源端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: source_port_range

fields.help_en: The action for matched traffic. A value of accept indicates that traffic is collected. A value of drop indicates that traffic is not collected
fields.help_zh: 匹配流量的处理动作。accept 表示采集，drop 表示不采集
fields.name: sub_rule_action

fields.help_en: The list of inbound filter sub-rules
fields.help_zh: 入方向过滤子规则列表
fields.name: ingress_sub_rules

fields.example: 采集指定网段的 TCP 流量
fields.help_en: The description of the filter rule. The description must be less than 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 过滤规则描述。少于 256 个字符，不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
fields.name: rule_description

fields.help_en: The name of the filter rule. The name must be less than 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 过滤规则名称。少于 128 个字符，不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
fields.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The filter rule snapshot used for new mirror sessions. If this parameter is not specified, all traffic is collected. This parameter does not replace the filter rules of existing mirror sessions
parameters.help_zh: 新建镜像会话使用的过滤规则快照。不传时采集全部流量；不会替换已有镜像会话的过滤规则
parameters.name: filter_rule

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: The filter condition based on the cloud service type to which the asset belongs. Use lowercase identifiers. Valid values: `ecs`, `eci`, and `acs`
fields.help_zh: 按资产所属云服务类型筛选，使用小写标识。支持引流的类型包括 `ecs`、`eci`、`acs`
fields.name: cloud_type

fields.help_en: The list of asset instance IDs. This condition is met if an asset instance ID matches any value in the list
fields.help_zh: 资产实例 ID 列表。资产实例 ID 命中列表中任一值即可
fields.name: instance_id_list

fields.help_en: The fuzzy match condition based on the asset instance name. You can specify the full name or a part of the name
fields.help_zh: 按资产实例名称模糊匹配，可传入完整名称或名称中的一段
fields.name: instance_name

fields.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the destination VPC belongs. If this parameter is omitted, the account to which the destination VPC belongs is used. If this parameter is specified, it must be the same as the account
fields.help_zh: 目标 VPC 所属阿里云账号 ID。省略时使用目标 VPC 所属账号。传入时须与该账号一致
fields.name: member_uid

fields.help_en: The page number of the asset list. Pages start from 1. If this parameter is omitted or set to `0` during pagination, the first page is returned. If both `Page` and `PageSize` are omitted, all pages are matched. If either parameter is specified, assets are paginated first, and then ENIs are matched from the assets on the specified page
fields.help_zh: 资产列表的页码，从 1 开始。分页时省略或传入 `0`，取第 1 页。 `Page` 和 `PageSize` 均省略时，匹配所有页面。传入任一字段时，先按资产分页，再从该页资产中匹配网卡
fields.name: page

fields.help_en: The number of assets per page. If this parameter is omitted or set to `0` during pagination, the default value 10 is used. If the value is greater than 100, 100 is used. If both `Page` and `PageSize` are omitted, all pages are matched. If either parameter is specified, assets are paginated first, and then ENIs are matched from the assets on the specified page
fields.help_zh: 每页的资产数量。分页时省略或传入 `0`，默认 10。大于 100 时按 100 处理。 `Page` 和 `PageSize` 均省略时，匹配所有页面。传入任一字段时，先按资产分页，再从该页资产中匹配网卡
fields.name: page_size

fields.help_en: Filters by the private IP address of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs)
fields.help_zh: 按弹性网卡的私网 IP 地址筛选
fields.name: private_ip_address

fields.help_en: The ID of the region where the destination VPC resides. If this parameter is omitted, the region where the destination VPC resides is used. If this parameter is specified, it must be the same as the region
fields.help_zh: 目标 VPC 所在地域的 ID。省略时使用目标 VPC 所在地域。传入时须与该地域一致
fields.name: region_no

fields.help_en: The list of asset collection statuses. This condition is met if any status matches. Valid values: `0` (not collected), `1` (partially collected), and `2` (fully collected)
fields.help_zh: 资产采集状态列表。任一状态匹配即可。取值为 `0`（未采集）、`1`（部分采集）或 `2`（全部采集）
fields.name: traction_status

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the destination VPC. If this parameter is omitted, the top-level `VpcInstanceId` is used. If this parameter is specified, it must be the same as the top-level value
fields.help_zh: 目标 VPC 的实例 ID。省略时使用顶层 `VpcInstanceId`。传入时须与顶层值一致
fields.name: vpc_instance_id

fields.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs to which the assets belong. This condition is met if an asset belongs to any vSwitch in the list
fields.help_zh: 资产所属的交换机 ID 列表。资产属于列表中任一交换机即可命中此条件
fields.name: vsw_instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: Creates an asynchronous traffic diversion task for elastic network interfaces (ENIs) that meet the connection conditions in the destination VPC based on filter conditions. When the task is executed, network interface controllers (NICs) are queried based on the filter conditions. If `Page` and `PageSize` are omitted, all pages are matched. To select all connectable network interface controllers (NICs) in the VPC, you can pass only the `VpcInstanceId` that is the same as the top-level parameter in the object. If `EniInstanceIdList` is not empty, elastic network interfaces (ENIs) are connected based on the list and this parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 按条件为目标 VPC 内符合接入条件的弹性网卡创建一个异步引流任务。任务执行时按筛选条件查询网卡。省略 `Page` 和 `PageSize` 时匹配所有页面。要选择整个 VPC 的可接入网卡，可只在对象中传入与顶层相同的 `VpcInstanceId`。 `EniInstanceIdList` 非空时，按该列表接入并忽略本参数
parameters.name: asset_filter

PrivateTractionId.description_en: The ID of the private network traffic diversion configuration

PrivateTractionTaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task for private network traffic diversion
PrivateTractionTaskId.description_zh: 私网引流异步任务 ID

VpcInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the VPC instance
